scope: Consolidate three reviewed dependency PRs into the existing forty-improvement branch; development validation remains local, followed by required protected-branch checks.

changes.reason: Separate updates failed because versioned configuration produced by init must exactly match analyze. Update both atomically.
Reviewed dependency-only patch; action metadata, inputs, application source and Node 24 runtime unchanged.

prevention: Dependabot groups all CodeQL steps together and batches other minor/patch action updates. The local security gate rejects absent or mismatched CodeQL steps.

validation.dependabotYaml: Parsed successfully with js-yaml4.1.1; group patterns and ordering reviewed against GitHub documentation.
validation.pairingGuard: Actual guard accepts aligned pins, rejects mismatched pins and missing analyze step.
validation.independentReviews: CodeQL pair, attestation update and final consolidation diff reviewed separately.
validation.applicationChecks: The original Node 22/24/26 gates are recorded in verification.json. Subsequent runtime recovery fixes and their final gates are recorded below.

hostedFollowUp.findings: Node 22 and conformance exposed default-zero SQLite busy timeout on concurrent crash-test reader connections. Node 24 and CodeQL passed.
hostedFollowUp.fix: Test readers and generated writers explicitly configure 5000ms busy handling; positive writer checks poll within 10s. No lock errors are swallowed; all cleanup, ordering, data-preservation and deletion assertions remain.
hostedFollowUp.stress: 20/20 affected tests passed under forced exclusive write locks on Node 22.16.0 and24.21.0. Removing only reader busy handling reproduced both failures.
hostedFollowUp.coverageArtifact: All 1590 tests completed with 0 failures, but one local Node coverage run produced trailing non-whitespace JSON data. Added this exact malformed-artifact error to the existing single bounded retry. Final valid measured coverage and unchanged 80/65/80 thresholds remain required.
hostedFollowUp.coverageGuardTests: 5/5 passed on Node 22,24,26; independent review found no bypass.

finalLocalGate.result: Full scripts/check.mjs passed including documentation, conformance, security and dependency checks.

runtimeRecovery.observation: Node 22, conformance and CodeQL passed. Node 24 reported a background startup recovery test failure, then retained a live test process; the stalled run was cancelled to retrieve logs.
runtimeRecovery.confirmedCause: Background recovery and ingress wakeup could both launch the same project before either published its active runtime. Isolated reproduction produced two same-release guardian fences, EADDRINUSE and ingress 503. The exact hosted orphan ordering was not reproduced.
fixes: Serialize recovery with ingress using the existing project lock and reload current project state inside that lock.
Wait for all sibling recovery operations before reporting coordination failures; do not mark an unstarted release crashed.
Check current lease and shutdown state immediately before spawn, after health and background startup, and before publication; clean rejected runtimes and unspawned fences.
Prevent stale controllers from overwriting successor release status.
Synchronize the ingress regression with a held application and verify exactly one runtime, a successful queued response and zero fences after close.
Allow the unchanged 30s crashed-controller lease to expire in the crash regression while continuously proving all old writer PID counts stay fixed.

proofs.result: 10/10 repeated natural exits across Node 22/24. Identical test against baseline fails with 503. Fixed isolated reproduction has one runtime and returns 200.

proofs.case: Lease acquisition failure with recovering sibling
proofs.result: Sibling recovery completes; one coordination failure is reported, unstarted release status remains unchanged, and close while a sibling is held clears every guardian fence.
Node 24 regression passes. Disabling launch guard starts a forbidden worker; disabling status guard overwrites successor active/null status. Both negative controls fail.
Node 22 focused regression passes naturally in 31.61s, including real lease expiry, no old-writer progress and successful stable recovery.

constraints: The release-only OIDC attestation operation is not invoked by PR CI and was not tested by publishing a release. No package was published.
